sentences.en: What terrible tragedies realism inflicts on people.
sentences.zh: 现实主义给人们带来了多么可怕的悲剧。

sentences.en: Floyd has faced the situation with realism.
sentences.zh: 弗洛伊德以一种现实的态度面对了这种情况。

sentences.en: He stood agape for a moment in front of the painting, surprised at its realism.
sentences.zh: 他站在画前呆了一会儿，惊讶于它的写实程度。

senses.zh: 现实主义，现实态度，注重实际；(文学创作的) 现实主义，写实主义
